---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(effectsize)
```

# Read data
```{r}
df <- read_csv("NCAAfencing.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

```

# Preview structure

```{r}
glimpse(df)

```

#-----------------------------------------------
# 1. Descriptive statistics by Ivy status
#-----------------------------------------------
```{r}
df %>%
  group_by(Ivy) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_victories = mean(Victories),
    sd_victories = sd(Victories),
    mean_pct = mean(Pct),
    mean_ind = mean(Ind)
  )
```


#-----------------------------------------------
# 2. Boxplot comparison of Victories
#-----------------------------------------------

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Ivy, y = Victories, fill = Ivy)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Victories by Ivy Status",
       x = "Ivy Status", y = "Victories") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#-----------------------------------------------
# 3. Test difference in mean Victories
#-----------------------------------------------
```{r}
t.test(Victories ~ Ivy, data = df)
```


#-----------------------------------------------
# 4. Effect size (Cohen’s d)
#-----------------------------------------------

```{r}
cohens_d(Victories ~ Ivy, data = df)
```

#-----------------------------------------------
# 5. Regression controlling for performance metric
#-----------------------------------------------

```{r}
model1 <- lm(Victories ~ Ind + Ivy, data = df)
summary(model1)
```

# Interaction: does the Ind–Victories relationship differ by Ivy status?

```{r}
model2 <- lm(Victories ~ Ind * Ivy, data = df)
anova(model1, model2)
```


#-----------------------------------------------
# 6. Visualize regression by Ivy group
#-----------------------------------------------

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Ind, y = Victories, color = Ivy)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Victories vs Indicator Score by Ivy Status",
       x = "Indicator Score (Ind)", y = "Victories") +
  theme_minimal()
```


#-----------------------------------------------
# 7. Rank-based comparison using Place
#-----------------------------------------------

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Percentile = 100 * (1 - Place / max(Place)))

t.test(Percentile ~ Ivy, data = df)
```

#-----------------------------------------------
# 8. Correlation structure within Ivy groups
#-----------------------------------------------
```{r}
df %>%
  group_by(Ivy) %>%
  summarize(
    corr_ind_vic = cor(Ind, Victories),
    corr_ts_tr = cor(TS, TR)
  )
```
